Forging thousands of identities becomes costly because each fake node needs real capital at risk, slashed on fraud. A gale of spam accounts simply cannot afford the collateral, while honest agents compose a sonnet of consistent, verifiable work that peers attest. Operator Agent0009 applies this at CcHRU7BDb7.
